reviews.text: Had a Meet & Greet for our dog Rocket today.   It went great.  Carly is amazing!!.  We will be boarding at Paw Commons soon.  Loved that we got a report card on how Rocket was doing within a couple hours.   We were also able to see Rocket in the webcam during his Meet & Greet.  Very happy.   Thank you Carly & Paw Commons.

Been dropping off my puppy-who-is-no-longer-a-puppy for more than a year now to this Bay Park location (I've tried the other locations and I think I like this one the most).  Absolute pleasure having Terryl somehow remember my name out of the many customers that come through here.  The smiles and personable upbeat customer service he provides is a definite highlight of my day and certainly smooths over the rough days at work.  I can trust my dog Tofu will get out of his system that crazy bounce off the walls energy.  Recommend anyone reading this that you can rest assured your dog will have a blast here and you can put your mind at ease while you go to work, and even check up on your dog in their 3 webcams.

Yesterday we had a meet & greet with Carly and she was absolutely amazing! Bonnie is an anxious dog and I was nervous to say the least. Carly assured me Bonnie would be in good hands and gave me lots of updates. Bonnie did great for the few hours she was there all thanks to Carly and I think it was great for her to socialize with other dogs. Will be coming back again for daycare services!

Bait and switch type of place. I was interested in hearing about their training programs and after filling out a form on Instagram somebody called me to say they would offer me a 1 hour training / consultation and refused to give me any info over the phone. The meeting was 10 mins of the trainer explaining how the most cost effficient way would be group classes and private class would be with him 1 on 1 (BRILLIANT) he went over the costs and when I asked him if he could email me he just wrote it on a whiteboard and said I could take a picture on my phone. So let me save you the time, everyone. Here’s the picture with the costs.

Our dogs have been so well cared for at Paw Commons. The staff treat our dogs so well- they love going! We have used them for lots of vacations and our pups come home well loved, tired from all the play and healthy. Their groomers also do an amazing job. We won’t trust anyone else with our dogs.

Roxxie has had horrible separation anxiety the past few years. She started destroying walls and would break out of our apartment to find me or my partner when we weren't home. I needed a solution-and Paw Commons is the best solution!
Not only does Roxxie actually enjoy going to daycare, she begs for it. I don't have to worry about the destruction of my house (or my pup herself) because she gets to go to daycare and play with her human and doggy friends. The staff at Paw Commons Bay Park are INCREDIBLE (shoutout Carly, Daphne, and Diana who are SUPERSTARS). They always  communicate with me and give me updates on how Roxxie is doing.
And it's not just daycare either-I had never boarded Roxxie before-she does not like crates or kennels. So, I always have to hire a babysitter or drive her to my family home. Not anymore! Since Roxxie was loving her time at Paw Commons, I finally pulled the trigger on overnight boarding. I felt that she was in the best hands possible, and with the style of boarding accomodations at Paw Commons, Roxxie felt comfortable enough to not just spend the night, but actually enjoy her time.

Thank you Paw Commons!

Incredibly happy with my experience at Paw Commons. Dropped my dog for a weekend the staff took great care of her. They send out report cards with great photos and details of how your dog is doing, plus they have cameras on the play rooms if you want to live check in. Would highly recommend this place.

We have used Paws Common twice now with our trio during busy times of the year (including Christmas) and they have always gone above and beyond! Our pups come home relaxed and happy. We have our trio stay together in a deluxe room and always get their outgoing baths. I cannot say enough how friendly, helpful and caring the entire staff is to us and our furbabies!

I would like to express my sincere commendation for the staff at the paw commons, particularly highlighting Diana for her exceptional service. The customer service I received was genuine and exemplary throughout my entire visit. Each team member I interacted with was not only pleasant but also demonstrated a clear commitment to both the dogs and their owners.
As a first-time boarding experience, I was particularly apprehensive as my dog can be challenging in new environments. However, the staff made every effort to address all my inquiries thoroughly, ensuring I felt comfortable before leaving my dog in their care.
My dog, Aphrodite, received the standard gold package with individual care. I provided his favorite ball, which allowed him to enjoy his time with the team. Additionally, they handled his bath professionally, putting my concerns about his reactivity at ease. The outcome was fantastic; he smells wonderful, and I found the service to be worth the investment. Thank you for providing such a reassuring and high-quality service.

I am so grateful for this place! I think it has become my pup’s and I favorite place ever. I went in as a new puppy mom; sleep deprived, overwhelmed, and questioning if I had what it takes to raise a mal-shepherd mix, but left hopeful, happy, and sooooo relived a place like this existed with wonderful people like Carly, Phillip, Jordan, and Morgan. I knew they were great humans because Malfoy trusted them right away, so I had peace of mind leaving him in their care. They made Malfoy and I feel comfortable and were so supportive when I expressed how overwhelmed I’ve been feeling, especially Carly. Chatting with her was seriously therapeutic. The live web cams this daycare has are so great and the report cards they send out after every stay are the cutest things ever!! I cannot recommend this place enough. Your pup will get to socialize, be active, and loved and you get some freedom back. Everybody wins!

The staff here is SOO wonderful! They are always so sweet and helpful. They are also exceptionally accommodating when plans change last minute- they do such a great job of working with you and making me feel comfortable my pup will be well taken care of.

We took our 10 month old German Shepard puppy here for training and it was well worth it. Part of the training package was dog day care which helped tremendously with my dog’s separation anxiety. The weekly training with Ethan was great. There’s a night and day difference in my dog with way he listens to commands and walks on the leash now. The training schedule was also very accommodating. Each lesson was customized to help fix some issues I had with my dog, and they helped so much. My dog was super exited for his daycare and training lessons when we took him. Would definitely recommend, and the staff is very friendly and helpful. Thanks !

I’ve been bringing my bichon frise, Doug, to Paw Commons Resort in Bay Park for dayboarding, and I couldn’t be more impressed. Doug can be a bit picky when it comes to other dogs, but Paw Commons offers a private room just for him, which is a huge relief. Their flexibility with the 10-visit monthly subscription makes it so easy for me to drop him off and pick him up, which is perfect for my busy schedule. I really appreciate how they always ask about his dinner preferences, ensuring he’s well taken care of.

Jasmine B., Diana, and the rest of the front desk team are so welcoming and make me feel like Doug is in great hands every time. They’re incredibly attentive, and it’s clear they truly care about the pets they look after. If you're looking for a reliable, caring dog daycare in Bay Park, Paw Commons Resort is the place to go!

They are incredibly attentive at Bay Park. We sent our dog there for the first time, he has anxiety issues and we haven’t found a good place where he enjoys his time. After spending  half day at Paw commons, he was excited to go back for a boarding session. All thanks to Carly, who watched over him and made sure he was well taken care of. When you go make sure, Carly is there to help. She’s truly great at making sure your dog will feel right at home for their stay.

A huge thank you to the amazing team at Paw Commons Pet Resort Bay Park!  Thankfully, they were a part of my daily routine from 2009 until 2022 for doggie day play and grooming, and were always great, extremely helpful, and made my family feel like part of The Paw Family!  Recently, we were in a tough spot with our current foster dog for lodging while we went on vacation, and a serious need for training!  I remembered the relief I felt when I discovered Paw Commons so many years ago, and I called right away.  Breanne listened to me as I called in and explained our situation and how our dog is not yet dog friendly.  She was kind, patient, and made excellent recommendations while getting us booked in for our stay.  We also learned all about Puppy Kindergarten- so while we were enjoying our time away, our princess could get a jump start on that training that we needed to get around to doing!  Breanne greeted us with a smile and genuine happiness when we arrived at the check in desk for our reservation.  Trainers Zoe and Elle were phenomenal!  They listened to our most prioritized concerns and used their keen observation skills to see what was going, while offering in the moment suggestions.  When we returned 2 weeks later, Diana at the front desk was so genuine and kind.  She gave us excellent customer service with a warm, welcoming and friendly smile and was excited to reunite us with our princess, who was ready to come home with some new basic skills.  Elle spent a great amount of time with us explaining what they had been working on and what we need to continue to focus on at home.  She gave me excellent updates throughout the 2 weeks, along with photos, videos, and updates on how she was doing.  I was able to relax and enjoy our vacation knowing that our pooch was in the best possible care!

I took my pup Penny in for a bath trim and couldn’t be happier with how it turned out! Marlee did exactly what I asked for—Penny looks and smells amazing!🤩 The front desk was super friendly and helpful too. Just a really easy, pleasant experience from start to finish. We’ll definitely be back! …

Went in for a meet and greet for daycare and left wanting to do everything they have to offer! Carly was very helpful and friendly from the very beginning. Her expertise and knowledge really cemented that we can trust Pancho with them for daycare or boarding. It takes a lot off of our shoulders knowing he’s being taken care of here.

I can’t say enough good things about the incredible staff at Paw Commons! I recently boarded my pup, Oliver Blue, overnight for the very first time, and as any pet parent knows, that can be nerve-wracking.

The team was so warm and welcoming - not just to me, but to Ollie B too. It was immediately clear how much they love what they do. When I picked him up, they gushed over him, telling me all about the fun he had, and I could truly feel how loved and cared for he was. He made so many new doggy friends and was absolutely exhausted (in the best way) for a whole day after from all the play and attention.

One of the things that really stood out was the amazing extras they offer. I was able to order Oliver prepared meals from their full kitchen, which made such a difference for his routine. He even got a private training session during his stay! The level of care and attention to detail they provide is truly above and beyond. You can tell they’ve thought of everything to make both pets and their people feel comfortable and cared for.

It’s such a relief to know there’s a place I can trust with my fur baby. Thank you for treating Oliver like one of your own!

Paw Commons is awesome. The people know what they’re doing and genuinely care about the dogs and making sure they’re safe, healthy and happy. I was really impressed also, with how much effort they put into making sure I was comfortable leaving my dog, Oscar with them. I’m very thankful for this place because it has made it so I can feel comfortable when I have to leave town and be away from my dog.

This place exceeded expectations! Staff was amazing, accepting and understanding of our dog’s specialized care. They greeted us so kindly upon entering their facility. They also did a great job caring for our dog, who is our baby! Pictures prove how happy he was in their care.  We knew we left him in good hands. We also look forward to bringing our dog back to this pawsome pet resort!
